title: 3D Asset Search Engine (242K+ free assets)
author: assentic
selftext:
TL;DR: 3D assets search engine - ready for agents (mcp,skill,api)  
  
Howdy game builder of the future,  
With the release of opus 5.5 and astra and the major jump in the capabilities of the model I had to give game building another chance and it was good!

One shot prompt was able to generate a fun playable Subway Surfers style game,  
I wanted to take it a bit further, and not having subscription to something like meshy I've looked free asset I could integrate

I didn't expect it to be actually a hard mission to find 3d assets!  
found poly heaven - which was cool but was not enough..

  
So I did what anyone with claude do this day - built myself the missing piece of the puzzle,  
I've research where can I find free assets found 17 of those and wrapped it with an API/MCP and gave claude - it was able to make the game look much better

If you want to give it a try you can run it yourself from the source code  
[https://github.com/arielshad/3d-asset-server](https://github.com/arielshad/3d-asset-server)  
or use [https://3d.shep.bot/](https://3d.shep.bot/) (you can point you agent at the url he would be able to understand what to do from there)

If you know any other website I can integrate to get more assets into the system let me know! would love to enrich it even further!

comments.author: DaedalusRaistlin
comments.body: Nice work. I built something fairly similar for my own use, purely to track my owned assets across the half a dozen sites I have them on. I didn't realise I had so many. It's got an api, and Claude searches it when it needs models, in a similar way to yours.

comments.author: No-Appointment-1652
comments.body: Really cool project! The before/after difference is impressive, and an asset search that agents can call directly is exactly what I've been missing. I'm going to try it with my own game project. Quick question: how well does it handle licensing info for each asset (CC0 vs. attribution required)? Thanks for open-sourcing it!

replies.author: assentic
replies.body: It returns the license in the response you can probably ask the agent for filter out based on your needs

replies.author: No-Appointment-1652
replies.body: That makes sense, thanks for the quick reply! I'll try it out and have my agent filter by license. Great work on this!
